name: Helicopter
summary: Bubble-cabin helicopter in side view with skids and tail rotor; the main and tail rotors spin in the fly animation.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the skids stands on y; it hovers in the air above the ground

params.name: s
params.note: scale: about 840 px wide (rotor tip to tip) and 410 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: fly = gentle hover; the main and tail rotors spin

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the cabin faces left

author: krakujs
